purpose: Prospective baseline-only diagnostic; no new algorithm

arms.A: Original synchronous ROSA; full original registry; common read-only CLI guard and instrumentation
arms.B: A plus strong ordinary efficient-use prompting
arms.C: B plus generic independent batch of known-argument read tools; no references, endpoint mapping, caching or automatic selection

guidance: Use independent tool calls together when possible. Reuse discovery and observations already acquired during this request while still valid. Read tool documentation and use supported list arguments to group reads. Do not repeat a successful read unless new information, a changed source, verification requested by the user, or recovery requires it. Preserve source identity. Distinguish publishers from subscribers and observed state from configuration. Acquire all requested fields, then answer from actual tool responses. Do not guess missing facts. If needed, explain unavailable information. An efficient incomplete answer is not success.

tasks.request: I am checking the simulated drawing display in /diag_turtle. Discover its running node and report its full name, configured background red/green/blue values, and the pose topic's full name, message type and publisher count. Return a JSON object with keys node, rgb (three integers), pose (object with topic, type, publishers).

Before clearing a simulated drawing, inspect /diag_turtle without changing it. Discover the running node, identify its clear and reset services with their full names and service types, and read whether that node uses simulated time. Return JSON with keys node, services (object mapping each of the two full service names to its type), use_sim_time (boolean). Do not call either service.

I need to connect a controller to the running turtle in /diag_turtle. Discover its node and inspect its interfaces. Report every application topic it publishes and every application topic it subscribes to, with full topic names and message types. Exclude /rosout and /parameter_events. Return JSON with keys node, publishers and subscribers; the last two are objects mapping topic names to message types. A subscribed command topic must not be reported as published.

Check the message connection on /diag_demo/chatter. Report its message type, publisher and subscriber counts, the full publisher and subscriber node names, and the use_sim_time value for each of those nodes. Discover the actual endpoints. Return JSON with keys topic, type, publishers (integer), subscribers (integer), endpoints (list of objects with node, role equal to publisher or subscriber, and use_sim_time boolean).

I want to connect a client to the arithmetic server in /diag_demo. Discover which node provides the application arithmetic service, report its full node name and all its non-parameter service names and types, and read its use_sim_time value. Do not invoke any service. Return JSON with keys node, services (object mapping full service names to types), use_sim_time (boolean). Exclude the standard parameter-management services.

Check clock configuration before I combine /diag_turtle and /diag_demo. Discover every running node in those two namespaces and read use_sim_time for each. Also report the message types and publisher counts of the turtle pose topic and demo chatter topic, discovering their full names. Return JSON with keys clocks (object mapping full node names to boolean values) and topics (object mapping each of the two full topic names to an object with type and publishers).

correctness.independence: Evaluation-only native node info, parameter dumps, topic info and service type snapshots before and after each six-episode block; never supplied to model. Exact task fields are frozen here before execution. Evaluate parsed JSON semantics, numeric strings separately from numeric values, format separately; manually adjudicate explanatory text without silently repairing omissions.
correctness.strict: Every requested field correct and complete, correct source identity, no unsupported extra factual claims. JSON framing scored separately. Missing or contradictory fields fail. Unstable oracle marks affected fields indeterminate, never a win.
correctness.efficiency: Only same-task same-repeat mutually strict-correct pairs. No savings inferred from total call differences alone. Native operations mean CLI subprocess attempts; DDS/service packet counts are not measured.

analysis_rules.unit: Each potentially avoidable operation cites episode and trace line with prior available evidence, validity assumptions, recovery context, requested information and corresponding controls.
analysis_rules.redundancy: Identical commands are only candidates. Proven redundancy requires prior successful same-source result, unchanged static field and graph corroborated by independent snapshots, no intervening write/recovery uncertainty, and no explicit refresh obligation.
analysis_rules.decision_savings: An independent read can share a model decision only if its full arguments were already available. Charge batch/schema/inference overhead; missed grouping is potential, not measured causal savings.
analysis_rules.go_gate: Recommend algorithm development only for a correctness-preserving, recurring witness in at least two tasks and both applications that survives B/C, with a plausible application-independent observable decision rule and net-cost evidence beyond ordinary batching/reuse. Otherwise recommend a targeted diagnostic. Small n and deterministic repeats limit generality.
analysis_rules.replay: Only if competing explanations need it; separate labeled protocol and records; no changes to frozen 36 cells.

stopping: 36 attempted cells or 3-hour wall budget; preserve setup failures/timeouts; no adaptive task changes, no retries replacing failed cells, no new algorithm phase.
